feature: Repository cleanup: delete dead V3/V4 code, prune docs, update entry points
problem: Repo has ~25K lines of dead code from V3/V4 that will confuse future development and bloat context
proposed_solution: Delete dead source, tests, scripts, evals, fixtures. Clean docs. Update entry points.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: No source file imports deleted modules (orchestrator, evidence_tagger, governance, models.investigation, models.trace, harness.harness, brief_validator, completion, llm_protocol, eval_metrics, baselines, d3_judge, run_eval)
AC2: No test file imports deleted modules — all test imports resolve
AC3: All tests pass (pytest tests/ -x) with zero failures or import errors
AC4: Package layout in AGENTS.md matches actual filesystem (ls src/commit_investigator/*/)
AC5: README.md pipeline diagram reflects V4.2 architecture (not V3)
AC6: project_domain.mdc references V4.2 pipeline (not V3)
AC7: No doc file references deleted source files (orchestrator.py, harness.py, eval_metrics.py, etc.)
AC8: __init__.py files export only symbols that exist in their respective packages
AC9: Superseded ADRs have SUPERSEDED banners (mechanism-design, topology-debate, cursor-sdk-multi-turn)
AC10: tools.py contains only scoped tools (build_scoped_tools) — no V3 build_attribution_tools
edge_cases: EC1: smoke_test_data.py imports select_eval_cases from deleted run_eval — this is a known issue (script needs V4.2 update), should be documented not fixed
EC2: v4_runner.py retains V4InvestigationResult dataclass (used by scoped_runner) but run_v4_investigation is deleted
verification_method: Grep for dangling imports, verify filesystem matches docs, run pytest, inspect __init__.py exports, check ADR banners
